overall.summary: No check fails, but 1 of 8 are borderline (Deflated Sharpe ratio): treat the selected setting's performance with caution.
overall.benchmark_summary: The checks ask whether the result could come from the search alone, not whether it beats the market: over the same dates the selected setting's Sharpe ratio was 0.80 against 0.64 for SPY buy and hold, and its annual return 9.7% against 10.8%.

holdout.title: Holdout split
holdout.summary: Picked on the first 70% of the history, the best setting's Sharpe ratio went from 0.79 to 0.82 over the remaining 9.8 years.

walk_forward.title: Walk-forward analysis
walk_forward.summary: Re-picking the best setting every 252 days on the previous 1260 days and trading it on the next period, it kept 61% of the in-sample return rate; the out-of-sample Sharpe ratio was 0.59.

purged_cv.title: Purged cross-validation
purged_cv.summary: Picking the best setting on 9 of 10 folds, with overlapping and embargoed days removed, gave an average Sharpe ratio of 0.69 on the held-out fold, against 0.80 on the folds it was picked on.

pbo.title: Probability of backtest overfitting
pbo.summary: In 5% of 12,870 ways to split the history into two halves, the best of 128 settings on one half ranked in the bottom half on the other.

deflated_sharpe.title: Deflated Sharpe ratio
deflated_sharpe.summary: With 128 settings tried (about 48 independent), the chance that the best one's true Sharpe ratio beats the 0.52 expected from the luckiest of them by chance is 95%.

track_record.title: Probabilistic Sharpe ratio
track_record.summary: Ignoring how many settings were tried, the chance that the selected setting's true Sharpe ratio is above zero is 100%; 4.4 years would be enough for 95% confidence.

min_backtest_length.title: Minimum backtest length
min_backtest_length.summary: With about 48 independent settings tried, luck alone produces a best Sharpe ratio of 0.80 in samples shorter than 8.0 years; this backtest covers 32.7.

sensitivity.title: Parameter sensitivity
sensitivity.summary: Settings next to the best one keep 93% of its Sharpe ratio of 0.80 on average.
